left.command: joint_position entry left_gripper (index 6) and the ee_pose left_gripper entry: the target opening width in metres, 0 = closed .. 0.057378 = open (the nominal gap between the finger pads), converted to the gripper's native drive coordinate; it switches at the row (no interpolation). Grasping: physical grasping only (no assisted grasping): closing on an object squeezes it with the gripper's PD force; friction holds it

right.command: joint_position entry right_gripper (index 13) and the ee_pose right_gripper entry: the target opening width in metres, 0 = closed .. 0.057378 = open (the nominal gap between the finger pads), converted to the gripper's native drive coordinate; it switches at the row (no interpolation). Grasping: physical grasping only (no assisted grasping): closing on an object squeezes it with the gripper's PD force; friction holds it

controller.type: joint position PD per DoF (Genesis), gravity included in the simulation
controller.note: targets are applied at the 40 Hz control rate and held over 10 physics step(s)

left_tcp.definition: the left gripper's tool frame (TCP): a fixed point near the closed finger pads; approach axis (hand -> fingertips) = local [1.0, 0.0, -0.023], finger-closing axis = local [0.0, 1.0, 0.011]. The ee_pose action, the proprio tcp pose and the IK use this frame.

right_tcp.definition: the right gripper's tool frame (TCP): a fixed point near the closed finger pads; approach axis (hand -> fingertips) = local [1.0, 0.0, -0.023], finger-closing axis = local [0.0, 1.0, 0.011]. The ee_pose action, the proprio tcp pose and the IK use this frame.

ik.solver: bounded least squares over the robot's Genesis forward kinematics, started from the seed (default: the reset pose)
ik.joints: the arm joints of each arm whose TCP is a target; the other arms keep their seed

kinematics.note: q = the arm joints of every arm (the order of joint_names, as proprio); the finger joints do not move any listed frame

def evaluate_state(self, state):
        poses, bounds, quiet, failure = self.rigid_measurements(state)
        if failure:
            return False, failure, {}
        gold, silver = "coil_gold", "coil_silver"
        pg, rg = poses[gold]; ps, rs = poses[silver]
        pg = pg-rg.apply(self.body_origins[gold])
        ps = ps-rs.apply(self.body_origins[silver])
        position_error = float(np.linalg.norm(ps-pg))
        rotation_error = float((rg.inv()*rs).magnitude())
        separation = float(np.max(np.maximum(bounds[silver][0]-bounds[gold][1],
                                             bounds[gold][0]-bounds[silver][1])))
        reached = (position_error < .001 and rotation_error < .02) if self.config["objective"] == "assemble" else separation > .01
        released = self.released(state)
        bottoms = [bounds[name][0][2]-self.table_height_m for name in (gold, silver)]
        near_table = (min(bottoms) if self.config["objective"] == "assemble" else max(bottoms)) <= self.config["terminal"]["table_clearance_m"]
        on_table = near_table and min(bottoms) >= -.001
        if hasattr(self, "table_xy_bounds"):
            lo, hi = self.table_xy_bounds
            on_table &= all(np.all(bounds[n][1][:2] >= lo) and np.all(bounds[n][0][:2] <= hi) for n in (gold, silver))
        return bool(reached and quiet and released and on_table), None, dict(
            relative_position_error_m=position_error, relative_rotation_error_rad=rotation_error,
            conservative_separation_m=separation, released=released, quiet=quiet,
            near_table=bool(on_table), minimum_table_gap_m=float(min(bottoms)))
grasp_rules: physical grasping only (no assisted grasping): closing on an object squeezes it with the gripper's PD force; friction holds it

public_goal.summary: Assemble the gold and silver Cast Coil pieces into their matching interlocking configuration, then release both.
success_conditions: Align the pieces' matching assembly frames with relative position error below 1 mm and relative angular error below 0.02 rad.
The bottom of at least one piece must be within 3 mm of the tabletop. Neither piece may extend more than 1 mm below it, and each piece must overlap the tabletop horizontally.
Keep both pieces' linear speeds below 1 mm/s and angular speeds below 0.02 rad/s. Merely touching or gripping them is not completion.

Release all target parts and disengage any assisted grasp. Withdraw the robot until there is at least 5 mm of verified clearance from every target part; opening the fingers while still touching or surrounding the target is insufficient.

During confirmation, every target point or rigid body's linear speed must be at most 1 mm/s and its displacement from the start of confirmation at most 1 mm. Each target rigid body's angular speed must be at most 0.02 rad/s and angular drift at most 0.02 rad.
failure_conditions: A piece falling more than 100 mm below the tabletop, or task contact penetration exceeding 1 mm, ends the episode in failure.
